top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a compact, analysable mechanism: the Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model predicted flat bands at a magic twist angle, and the 2018 experiments found correlated insulating and superconducting states there, reproduced by many groups and now a general control parameter across van der Waals systems. The three-name allocation (MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero, Bistritzer) keeps the theory half intact, and the citation can be limited to established phenomena. I accept that age, the open pairing mechanism and the omitted first author are real weaknesses, so P001 follows closely as the more mature and cleanly attributed prize, then P003, where the credit chain around Molenkamp, Kane, Mele and the Zhang group is conventional, and finally no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no known collaboration or institutional tie to any laureate in the slate, only shared Gothenburg physics environment with two colleagues
